title: Quick check: Feature-Based Application Organization

questions.prompt: In the context of “Feature-Based Application Organization” and “Domain-oriented features”, What is a maintainable way to organize a growing application?
options: Put all application logic in one oversized page component.
Separate route composition, reusable UI, trusted data access, and domain/business rules into clear modules.
Copy the database schema into every UI component.
Mix production credentials with public course content.
questions.answer_key: Separate route composition, reusable UI, trusted data access, and domain/business rules into clear modules.
questions.explanation: Explicit boundaries make application logic reusable, testable, and easier to secure.

questions.prompt: While implementing “Feature-Based Application Organization”, Why centralize data access behind server-only functions?
options: It prevents all database failures automatically.
It requires all code to run in the browser.
It gives the application a clear place for query logic, data shaping, and permission-aware access.
questions.answer_key: It gives the application a clear place for query logic, data shaping, and permission-aware access.
questions.explanation: Data-access modules centralize responsibilities but must still validate callers, handle errors, and limit returned fields.

questions.prompt: When reviewing “Feature-Based Application Organization”, What should a technical design record?
options: Key decisions, trade-offs, data boundaries, test strategy, operating assumptions, and how to verify the design.
Secrets and passwords to simplify setup.
A list of features with no explanation of data flow or failure behavior.
questions.answer_key: Key decisions, trade-offs, data boundaries, test strategy, operating assumptions, and how to verify the design.
questions.explanation: Professional workflows preserve the reasoning needed to review, operate, and change a system safely.

review_note: Draft question set with module-specific concepts. Review item wording and answer accuracy before publication; learner-facing APIs should expose prompt/options only and release correctness feedback after grading.
